FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 93
Committee: County and Municipal Sponsor: Representative Troy Stubbs
Government
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/09/2024
House Bill 93 as introduced could reduce the potential obligations of county commissions for
reimbursement of litigation costs and damages regarding the use of public funds under certain
conditions.
